scope: Karma application, API, Korean/English pages, UI, image assets and deployment output
fixes: Keep untrusted result text inert through automatic sentence formatting; escape shared chart values and normalize compatibility scores before HTML interpolation.
Use locally defined tarot card identities when restoring public shares.
Cancel stale tarot reading timers after deselection and prevent duplicate reading starts; reject duplicate or null cards at the API boundary.
Clear previous lucky values when a subsequent daily/yearly reading omits them.
Preserve shared result query parameters and fragments during language changes.
Return localized 400 responses for malformed analysis requests, impossible dates and invalid birth times without invoking AI.
Release loading overlays when legacy matching APIs reject requests and avoid treating API errors as empty match lists.
Exclude nested Markdown documentation and internal QA files from public build output.

verification.analysisFlows: All seven analysis types in Korean and English rendered using deterministic AI responses; non-tarot forms also recovered after injected HTTP 503 responses. Changed chart flows were repeated on final sources.
verification.browserSecurity: Injected HTML stayed inert through both sentence formatters and through the actual shared-tarot URL restoration path.

visualVerification.method: Compared baseline Git sources with final sources after document, font and image loading; used identical external resources and paused animations.
visualVerification.result: All measured headings, cards, controls and image containers retained identical positions and dimensions. No visible design change; tiny rasterization differences remain in some captures.
visualVerification.expectedErrorStateDifference: The six legacy matching pages now dismiss failed loading overlays; the unavailable matching APIs remain disabled.

productionEvidenceBeforeRelease.recentError: One saju AI response contract failure at 2026-11-02 22:34:15 in the existing KST database timestamps; existing bounded retries and error recovery remain in place.
preservedPolicies: private R2 persistence before valid photo analysis

limits: Browser flow fixtures verify rendering and error recovery, not the accuracy of generated readings.
Transient external AI provider failures cannot be excluded by local regression tests.
Some desktop requests cancel the unused mobile background resource while switching to the desktop source; the rendered images and final resource responses are valid.
